programs.title: DocFilm
programs.desc: In Cape Town, South Africa, a remarkable cloud phenomenon sometimes crowns Table Mountain. Known as the "tablecloth," this misty blanket spills over the flat summit to drape itself over the cliffs, ocean and city below.
